title: Pineapple Tofu Skewers with Bell Pepper-Tomato Salad & Rice

steps.text: If using wooden skewers, place 8-12 skewers in a shallow dish of water to soak until you are ready to use them.

Cut tofu in half along the long side. Sandwich tofu between clean towels or paper towels and place on a baking sheet pan. Place a cutting board with something heavy on top and set aside to press out excess water.
Using a strainer or colander, rinse the rice under cold, running water, then drain and transfer to a medium saucepan. Add water and bring the mixture to a boil over high heat.
Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce.

Once the liquid comes to a boil, stir the mixture, cover the saucepan, and reduce heat to low. Cook rice until liquid is fully absorbed, 15-18 minutes. Once done, remove rice from the heat and let it stand, still covered, for 5 minutes.
While the rice is cooking, cut off skin from pineapple; quarter, core, and large dice the flesh. Place in a medium bowl.
Large dice tofu. Add to the bowl with the pineapple along with oil and spices; stir to coat.
Thread pineapple and tofu onto skewers, alternating ingredients; place on a plate. Alternatively, you can cook the tofu and pineapple pieces directly on the grill pan without using skewers.
Preheat a grill pan or regular skillet over medium-high heat.
Once the pan is hot, working in batches if necessary, add the skewers and grill, turning occasionally, until pineapple and tofu are golden, 8-10 minutes. Return to the plate.
Meanwhile, shave cilantro leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Place in a clean medium bowl.
Juice one lime into the bowl with the cilantro. (Cut remaining lime into wedges and set aside for serving.)
Peel and mince shallot. Add to the bowl along with oil, maple syrup, and spices. Whisk to combine the dressing.
Trim, seed, and small dice bell peppers. Add to the bowl with the dressing.
Small dice tomatoes. Add to the bowl and stir to combine the salad.
Divide rice, salad, and skewers between plates. Serve with lime wedges on the side. Enjoy!
